race.comment: Keen on MAGNASPIN (2) in the Moe Cup now that he's found some form. His past two starts have been strong, just missing in the Seymour Cup two back then boxing on well for third at Flemington behind Sabaj. Rock hard fit and will be very hard to run down. SMOKIN' ROMANS (1) has to rebound from a plain G3 Coongy Cup run but his best is absolutely good enough and the G3 sixth two back is solid form. GRAND PIERRO (6) was held up in a BM96 on Cup Day and has a genuine excuse for the 12th, while his earlier G3 Bendigo Cup fifth reads well. Will be strong late. BRING FORTH (7) presents third up having made nice improvement in the Kyneton Cup. Peaks now and should go well. REGAL LION (8) can sneak into the finish.
